## Safe reproduction
Use mocks or disposable, backed-up media. Do not include commands that others might accidentally run on valuable disks.

## Evidence
Attach sanitized logs/screenshots. Remove serials, private paths and disk contents. For sensitive problems, follow SECURITY.md instead.
